# MSCI-2025-Q3-OPERATING-TAX-EPS-BRIDGE — Research-State Replay

**Scope note:** This is a source-bounded research-state replay, not a trade request. All figures below are reported GAAP displayed values from the two SEC exhibit packets. The comparison is **sequential (CY2025 Q3 vs CY2025 Q2)** only — no prior-year Q3 comparatives were supplied, so nothing here is year-over-year. No adjusted/non-GAAP measures were supplied, so no reported-vs-adjusted comparison is possible. No valuation, durability, or trading conclusion is drawn.

## 1. What the stored state said
- Thesis `th_fe166d28417a456f9fcd` (MSCI, US), status `active`, conviction 3, version 1, no prior reviews, no assumptions/catalysts/invalidations, nine required event metrics.
- Baseline evidence `HOLDOUT-MSCI-BASELINE-v1`, SHA-256 `c47970d6…05d26c`, period ended 2025-06-30.
- Alert `fa_375a5e76789b400aadf9` (version 1, status `new`), event `HOLDOUT-V2-MSCI-EVENT`, as_of 2025-10-28, source `HOLDOUT-MSCI-EVENT-v1`, SHA-256 `ea1ff1fe…386d2f`. All nine required metrics present; no source claims, no unresolved conflicts. Deterministic match returned `symbol_match` only (score 0) — no term-level thesis linkage.

## 2. Supported implication (arithmetic on selected rows)
Revenue rose 20,747 USD_thousand (+2.69% of baseline) while total operating expenses fell 1,709 USD_thousand (−0.49%), so operating income rose 22,456 USD_thousand (+5.28%). Operating margin moved from ~55.03% to ~56.43%, i.e. **+1.39 percentage points** — a margin-level change, not a relative percent. Pretax income rose 18,668 USD_thousand (+4.94%); the tax provision fell 3,068 USD_thousand (−4.14%), moving the effective tax rate from ~19.64% to ~17.94% (**−1.69 percentage points**). Net income rose 21,736 USD_thousand (+7.16%) and diluted EPS rose 0.33 USD_per_share (+8.42%) on diluted weighted-average shares down 917 thousand (−1.18%).

The pretax bridge closes exactly on the selected rows (OPINC − OTHEREXP = PRETAX in both periods), so **no residual is attributed to listed components**, and no absolute loss or tax dollars are inferred from any rate.

## 3. Material counterpoint
Other expense net rose 3,788 USD_thousand (+7.99%), a partial offset to the operating improvement. Also, EPS growth (+8.42%) exceeds net income growth (+7.16%) while the share count fell only 1.18%; the supplied rows do not decompose that gap between the share-count effect, rounding, and other factors, so no split is asserted. Finally, the tax-rate decline is a rate observation only — the packet contains no tax items or discrete-item detail, so its recurrence is unknown.

## 4. Missing evidence
Prior-year Q3 comparatives; adjusted/non-GAAP measures and GAAP reconciliation; segment and revenue-line detail; operating expense composition; other-expense composition; share repurchase/issuance detail; tax items and guidance; cash flow, balance sheet, capital return; management commentary and forward guidance. The thesis itself also carries no assumptions, catalysts, or invalidation conditions to test the event against.

## 5. Research-state decision
**needs_review**, impact **mixed**. Persisted as review `tr_f74c610cc2c44c2f8d18` at thesis version 2 (optimistic check on version 1), linked to alert `fa_375a5e76789b400aadf9` and both source SHA-256 hashes. Status and conviction were left unchanged (active / 3).

## 6. Verification
- Alert `fa_375a5e76789b400aadf9` updated to `acknowledged` at version 2.
- Re-read of the thesis confirms the block held: `decision_hold: true`, `actionability: "blocked"`, `decision_hold_alert_id: "fa_375a5e76789b400aadf9"`, version 2, `next_review_at` 2026-11-07. The needs_review decision preserved status and conviction and blocks downstream decisions.

No trades were placed and no investment recommendation is made.
